note: The trusted bases a build may start from (WORKPLAN-BUNDLES.md 'Base images, recipes and runtime projection'). Keyed by content type, language, exact language version, architecture and recipe revision. Each entry names its reviewed Dockerfile, the upstream it is FROM by digest, and the versions inside it the recipe relies on. dev/validate-bases.sh builds every entry through the configured mirror and checks each recorded fact against the built image. Additional language versions are additive entries, never 'latest'.

bases.system_package_licenses_note: Summaries of /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright in the built image, which is authoritative: for a machine-readable copyright file, the License names it gives (per file, in its order); otherwise read by hand. Build tools and libraries inside the base, used to compile R packages and loaded by the running app; nothing here is linked into Skald. Revision 2 (2026-10-18) adds GPL-licensed libraries to what an app loads (libpoppler, through GDAL), on the same footing as R itself and the rocker image: run, not linked.
